description:
Get account-level insights: reach, views, interactions, likes, comments, shares, saves, follows and profile link taps.

Defaults to the full interaction metric set for the last 7 days as totals. Narrow with metrics, or split a metric with breakdown (one metric at a time when using a breakdown).

For audience age/city/country/gender use instagram_get_audience_demographics instead.

Examples:
  - "how did we do last week" -> defaults
  - "reach split by followers vs non-followers" -> metrics=["reach"], breakdown="follow_type"

account_id.description: Instagram professional account ID. Omit to use the token's own account.

breakdown.description: Split the result along a dimension. Only valid with metric_type=total_value and only for metrics that support it — check instagram_list_metric_catalog.

metric_type.description: 'total_value' returns one total per metric and supports breakdowns; 'time_series' returns a daily series and ignores breakdowns.

metrics.description: Metric names. Omit for the default set: reach, views, total_interactions, likes, comments, shares, saves, replies, follows_and_unfollows, profile_links_taps, accounts_engaged. See instagram_list_metric_catalog.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

since.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 7 days ago. Meta allows at most 30 days per call.

until.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: instagram_get_account_insights
title: Get Account Insights
